workflowName: GBS SMS Safety Gate - HARD OFF (INACTIVE)
backupKind: sanitized logic and topology; NOT directly importable; no credentials

nodes.name: Evaluate SMS Eligibility - HARD OFF
nodes.logic: const hardKillSwitch=true;return $input.all().map(item=>{const e=item.json||{};const blockers=[];if(hardKillSwitch)blockers.push('sms-kill-switch-active');if(!String(e.inquiryKey||'').startsWith('rfc:'))blockers.push('missing-rfc-inquiry-key');if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(e.customerEmail||'')))blockers.push('invalid-customer-email');if(!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(String(e.sentAt||'')))||Date.now()<Date.parse(String(e.sentAt||''))+86400000)blockers.push('24-hour-wait-not-verified');if(e.threadRootVerified!==true)blockers.push('thread-root-not-verified');if(e.exclusiveClaimVerified!==true)blockers.push('exclusive-inquiry-claim-not-verified');if(e.allFiveReplyChecksPassed!==true)blockers.push('reply-check-incomplete');if(e.customerReplied!==false)blockers.push('customer-reply-unknown-or-present');if(e.consentEvidenceVerified!==true||!e.consentSource||!e.consentGivenAt)blockers.push('documented-consent-not-verified');if(e.optOutStatusVerified!==true)blockers.push('opt-out-status-unverified');if(e.optedOut!==false)blockers.push('customer-opted-out-or-unknown');if(!/^\+[1-9]\d{9,14}$/.test(String(e.phoneE164||'')))blockers.push('phone-not-e164');if(e.callLoopFromVerified!==true)blockers.push('call-loop-sender-not-verified');if(e.existingEstimateReminder!==false)blockers.push('estimate-follow-up-overlap-unknown-or-present');if(e.alreadySent!==false)blockers.push('prior-sms-unknown-or-sent');return {json:{inquiryKey:String(e.inquiryKey||''),smsEligible:false,smsSendingEnabled:false,status:'BLOCKED',blockers,eligibleAfterSourceChecks:blockers.filter(x=>x!=='sms-kill-switch-active').length===0,note:'Hard kill switch active. This workflow never sends customer messages.'}};});
